turns.assessment: The outage is a bidirectional loss on the S05–S15 cable at the same physical 78.3 km aerial segment. In the S05→S15 direction, OSC is lost on span0 and amp1 loses input; in the reverse direction, OSC is lost on the corresponding span2 and the preamp loses input. Simultaneous total signal loss across all channels, with stable pump-current telemetry, strongly indicates a cable fibre cut rather than an amplifier or channel-specific failure.

proposals.rationale: E6 is the S05→S15 fibre of the 78.3 km aerial segment. Its OSC loss and the downstream amplifier input loss localize the break there; simultaneous OSC and signal loss on reverse counterpart E16 indicates both fibres of the same cable were cut.
Extreme added loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but abrupt complete bilateral loss is much more characteristic of a fibre cut.
